title: The Person, Head To Hand
label: ch:la-mujer-y-la-cara
canDo: I can say la mujer, la cara, la nariz, el dedo and el corazón, and point at a person and name a part of them.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C364-corazon: name a person, then a face, a nose, a finger and the thing that beats underneath.
